description: This file provides a set of shell functions for managing system services via start-stop-daemon. It includes functions to start, stop, check status, reload, and send signals to services, with configurable environment variables for behavior customization.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to control a service (start, stop, check, etc.) using start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if the service is alive.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the service process.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service gracefully, with timeout and fallback to kill.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the service using a specified reload signal.
